2607.14675.title: An Intelligent-Cloud Edge Multimodal Interaction System for Robots
2607.14675.paper_summary: Robust human-robot interaction in complex environments requires accurate gesture perception, semantic scene understanding, and reliable task planning under limited onboard computing resources. This paper presents a cloud-edge multimodal interaction framework that integrates an enhanced YOLO-based gesture detector with coordinated large language model (LLM) and vision-language model (VLM) agents. The proposed detector, incorporates the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) into the neck and replaces the baseline bounding-box regression objective with Distance-IoU (DIoU) loss. These modifications improve feature discrimination and localization for small or partially occluded gestures in complex backgrounds. The cloud layer performs gesture detection, scene understanding, multimodal fusion, and action planning, whereas the TonyPi robot locally handles data acquisition, communication, action execution, and feedback. Experiments on a public gesture dataset and a custom dataset show that YOLO-DC achieves precision values of 98.9% and 95.0%, with mAP@0.5 values of 90.7% and 92.7%, respectively. System-level evaluation yields success rates of 95%, 88%, and 82% for single-action, composite-action, and vision-dependent tasks. A 30 participant evaluation yields an overall mean satisfaction score of 3.69 out of 5. These results demonstrate the feasibility of combining refined gesture detection with multimodal agents for resource-constrained robotic interaction.
2607.14675.paper_summary_zh: 穩健的人機互動在複雜環境中需要準確的手勢感知、語義場景理解以及在有限的機載計算資源下可靠的任務規劃。<lb/>本文提出了一個雲邊多模態互動框架，該框架將增強的基於YOLO的手勢檢測器與協調的大型語言模型（LLM）和視覺語言模型（VLM）代理整合在一起。<lb/>所提出的檢測器在頸部集成了卷積區塊注意力模組（CBAM），並用距離IoU（DIoU）損失替換了基線邊界框回歸目標。<lb/>這些修改提高了在複雜背景中對小型或部分遮擋手勢的特徵區分和定位能力。<lb/>雲層執行手勢檢測、場景理解、多模態融合和行動規劃，而TonyPi機器人則在本地處理數據採集、通信、行動執行和反饋。<lb/>在公共手勢數據集和自定義數據集上的實驗顯示，YOLO-DC的精度值分別達到98.9%和95.0%，mAP@0.5值分別為90.7%和92.7%。<lb/>系統級評估對單一行動、複合行動和視覺依賴任務的成功率分別為95%、88%和82%。<lb/>30名參與者的評估顯示整體平均滿意度得分為3.69（滿分5分）。<lb/>這些結果證明了在資源受限的機器人互動中，將精細的手勢檢測與多模態代理結合的可行性。
